name: 10-ssh-exec
teaches: host:ssh/exec runs a command on another machine, and the scope pins which one: host, user, key path, and a required host key or fingerprint, all validated at startup by name. Local exec is a separate connector, unwired here, so 'exec/run' answers denied the way any unwired family does; 16-exec wires it.
cmd: echo '$ drt run --config deploy.json'; drt run --config deploy.json; echo "exit $?"; echo; echo '$ drt run app.dlua'; drt run app.dlua; echo "exit $?"
